Where is Hans from?
questions.readingPassage: Hi! I'm Hans. I'm from Germany, but this year I am in London as an exchange student. I stay with a host family. My neighborhood is quiet and green. There is a park near my house, and the supermarket is next to the bank. I love movies. My favorite genres are sci-fi and comedy. We usually watch a movie on Friday nights. My favorite actor is Brad Pitt. In my free time, I go hiking twice a week. At home, I sometimes play online games. In the future, I want to be an engineer.
